articles.summary: LAKEWOOD, Colo., Nov. 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Mesa Laboratories, Inc. (NASDAQ:MLAB) (“Mesa” or “the Company”), a global leader in the design and manufacture of critical quality control solutions and life sciences tools, today announced results for its second fiscal quarter (“2Q27”) ended September 30, 2026, and issued full-year guidance for the first time (dollars in thousands, except per-share amounts). 2Q27 Financial Summary – (comparisons are versus the same prior year period) Revenues increased 2.6% to $62,336 Non-GAAP organic and constant currency organic revenues 1 growth was 2.6% and 3.1%, respectively Non-GAAP revenues excluding Clinical Genomics 6 increased 5.2% (5.8% constant currency) to $52,171; for the first six months, 3.2% (3.3% constant currency) to $102,020 Sterilization and Disinfection Control revenues increased 14.6% to $25,342; over the last twelve months, the division increased 8.5% to $103,897, the highest twelve-month total revenues in the division’s
articles.title: Mesa Labs Announces Second Quarter Fiscal Year 2027 Results and Issues First Full-Year Guidance
